what: Anchor Throw (Бросок якоря) target frames, Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5 medium 1k, 16:9, 1344x752
mechanic: anchor flies on its chain in a straight line ~7 m, hits everyone on the line, the return yanks them toward Pelag

picked.A-base.png: = A-base-v2 (cleaner painted turquoise ribbon along the chain, 3 guardians on the line hooked with foam splashes, 2 off the line untouched, leather grip + red tassel visible)
picked.B-net.png: = B-net-v1 (cobalt woven foam net with white knots, 6 guardians raked; v2 is the same idea but 8 guardians, reads more like an ultimate)
picked.C-fan.png: = C-fan-v2 (three clearly anchor-shaped heads: real iron anchor in the middle on the iron chain, two indigo-violet water-ghost anchors on water chains; v1 ghosts read as splashes)
picked.D-harpoon.png: = D-harpoon-v2 (single elite stabbed, magenta bite splash, drag furrow, others untouched, grip with red tassel; v1 also good, elite has antler crown and the sabre is visible at the hip)

A-base-v1.png.note: ribbon reads as a thin beam

known_flaws: the anchor head at the far end is small and sometimes reads as a double grapnel rather than our crescent-arm anchor; Pelag is game-camera small, so hands/grip are only roughly legible
